name: Emperor Metals Inc.
summary: Emperor Metals Inc. is a Canadian mineral exploration firm that focuses on the acquisition, exploration, and development of gold deposits. The company holds interests in several early-stage gold projects, including Pine Grove, all located within the western portion of Ontario's prolific Wawa-Abitibi Gold Belt, in close proximity to the Hemlo Gold Mine. Originally incorporated in 2020, Emperor Metals Inc. was formerly known as Alchemy Resources Corp., having adopted its current name in October 2020. Its headquarters are situated in Edmonton, Canada.
